response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A4.1"], "rationale": "The claim involves medical treatment (hospitalization and examinations) resulting from a head injury (otřes mozku) during a trip. Clause A4.1 covers necessary and reasonable medical expenses incurred due to an acute illness or injury during the trip. There is no indication that the injury was pre-existing, planned, or related to excluded activities (e.g., alcohol, war, terrorism). The policy explicitly includes extreme sports, so clause A11.3 does not apply here."}
